_readme: Risk acceptances for the CI dependency gate (scripts/audit-gate.js, FedRAMP plan A1 · RA-5). One entry per advisory and package, with why the risk is accepted and when the acceptance runs out. An expired entry fails CI again. Remove an entry once the advisory is fixed.

exceptions.reason: Dev-server only (launch-editor existence check). Vite is build tooling: none of it ships in the browser bundle, and the dev server runs only on developer machines, inside the Linux dev container. Fixed by the Vite 5 -> 6.4.4+ upgrade, tracked separately.

Reached only through @vite-pwa/assets-generator, a devDependency used by `npm run pwa:icons`, run by hand on our own logo SVG. Not used by the build, not shipped. Fixed by @vite-pwa/assets-generator 2.x.
Same scope as GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (icon generator only, not shipped).
